name: @red-cup-engineering/guard-http-request-service
description: Turn one request's headers, a validate die (bearer token -> identity claims | null) and a judge die (identity claims -> boolean) into a bearer-auth decision: {status: 200, claims} when a token validates and the judge admits it, {status: 401, challenge} when no bearer token was presented, or {status: 403, challenge} when a token validates but the judge refuses it. Use it to guard an HTTP resource behind a bearer token without hard-coding any one site's realm or transport framework.
